query: How does the battery of the Google Pixel 3 XL hold up during a full day, and do owners report unexpected drain?
search_text: How does the battery of the hold up during a full day, and do owners report unexpected drain?

rows.text: Comes with dying battery.. Phone works and looks great! The only problem is the battery. Running a system diagnostic tool reveals there is only a third of the charge left. And that drains very quickly. In just six hours, with battery saver on and very little use at work, it goes from full charge to dead and unusable.

Phone's battery drains at lightning speed. Hi thegadgetdeals. I was happy that the phone came in smooth condition however it turned into a disappointment when I noticed that the battery drains too fast. The phone hardly lasts 2h with continued use. This was supposed to be refurbished, right? But why ship a dying phone? You guys were supposed to replace a dying battery with a new/decent one.

Great adaptive battery life, some days with 2 full days of use, and some just a day if I'm using it for a lot. I did buy headphone adapters as I still have some auxiliary cable products. Save your money, its worth it.

Battery life is nil. Great phone, if it weren't for the battery life. I have gone through and removed, or disabled, all apps that drain the battery unnecessarily. Yet I still have to charge this thing about 3 times a day. If I go out for any amount of time I have to bring an external battery with me. And this is the version (XL) that is supposed to have an extended battery life.

Battery needs replaced after one day. The phone itself seems to be working fine, but after one day of use the battery is already being eaten 10 to 12% per hour. when I asked them to pay for a battery replacement they said I could return this phone for a full refund. However, that will leave me without a cell phone which I cannot be without it because I conduct business on it and I have five children. They test the batteries, but stated if they're not below a certain percentage they do not replace them. I think that should be made more clear. Now I'm probably going to be out over $100 by the time I get an expert to replace this battery. So all in all the phone is fine, but you better make sure just pointed questions about the battery before buying from them.

Great except for the battery. Phone is in immaculate condition. Everything about it is great, except the battery. It was dead when I got it, now that it's set up I'm barely getting through the work day on a full charge. That's disappointing, but otherwise the phone is amazing. I'm not sure if this is a refurb problem or just expected

Great phone, awful battery. Works great and even better for the price but the battery gets drained so fast, even more outfits with the screen on high brightness, I have left home with 100% battery and just as I walk to my car the battery will be at 97% can't complain for a used phone but it's a huge problem.

Always a Gamble with Refurbished. Having had a pixel before, I knew what to expect. That being said, I never had a refurbished one. I should have just sprung for something new. It looks great, absolutely no scratches. Really had my fingers crossed knowing that the battery can't be replaced in a pixel. Naturally, that's the main issue with this device. It holds a charge but drains so quickly even without much use. Sometimes it will get hot. I'm certain the battery will be toast before long. Also, there are certain areas on the screen that don't respond well to touch. For example, I'll often have to press the a on the keyboard button multiple times in order for it to register. Not an issue with other letters, so it's clearly a case where the previous owner really liked using the letter a!
Battery Drains Quickly. Battery hog. Even with no apps running

Battery goes dead in 10 minutes from a full charge. From the first day I used this phone the battery only last 10 minutes from a fully charged battery. I was hoping it would get better after a few software updates but it has not got any better. When they refurbished this phone they obviously didn't check the battery. This phone is absolutely useless. I have to leave it plugged into the charger all the time.
Battery life is terrible!. Brought a replacement pixel 3 for my wife. She states phone battery doesn’t hold a charge.

Great price.. There were absolutely no blemishes on the phone or scratches at all. However, I am concerned about the battery and what this phone was used for in the past. It came mostly charged but I powered it down and gave it a full charge but it seems to be losing charge rapidly even when only using Reddit or something like that. If I had to guess I'd say that my original pixel 3 XL that I bought when they came out has a battery and better shape than what's in these. Go ahead and buy one if you want to just replace the battery it's probably still not a bad deal.

I know this is with any device since it needs to update and do routine things, but 2/7 days of the week my phone will be at 80% (~10% at end of shift) in the hour it takes to get to work, while other days it will be at 95%. Battery life not so good. I waited a few days to write a review just to get a feel for how well the Pixel 3xl held up. The phone looked brand new when I opened it. There is no scratches or scuff marks. I also had no problems activating with my carrier. I love everything about this phone except the battery life. I'm not sure if it's normal for this phone, but my battery only last anywhere from 5 to 6 hours after fully charging. That's the only reason I gave the phone a 3 star rating. The seller was quick to ship and phone was exactly as described in the listing.

Love it. It's as good as the review say an then some. Battery (in battery saver mode) last me all day and most of the night under regular use (audible, surfing, and phone call). Recharges quickly. Camera is exceptional.

A bit too good to be true.... I bought this phone thinking that I would have a cheaper alternative to a new Pixel 3 XL, but when I tried to activate it at the Amazon store, the phone came back as stolen/ missing, and suspended my phone number. It took 3 hours to re-activate it. During my time writing this review waiting for my old phone to work again, the battery on this device drained unexpectedly quickly; it was half charge within the hour. I've bought with Amazon refurbished before with better results, but this is the worst purchace I've done. I understand that refurbished products aren't perfect and it is a really good looking phone, but having it suspend my phone number is not up my standards.

Phon=♥️ Battery=🤬. I absolutely love, love, love this phone. However the battery life is terrible. It's drains from 100% to 0% within 2.5-3hrs . Other than... This is my favorite phone to date. heart suit heart suit heart suit mobile phone

I have found myself charging this thing twice a day with normal use. 3 times even with heavy use... if you're taking a lot of photos it will just eat your battery. For example, I recorded 8 minutes of the 4th of July fireworks in NYC, it consumed 15-20% of the battery. That's just crazy. But all this little issues has been resolved with the Android Q, even it being a beta is just much more stable than the current official Android 9. If you want this Pixel, go for it. It's a great phone. And I hope Android Q will resolve those little issues.

Great except for battery. Only had it a few days but Love it. Camera is great. Runs fast. Screens span calls. Seems to be in good condition. Battery totally sucks. I ordered a battery charging case to see if that fixes it. Want something that will last all day without being attached to a charger. If that doesn't fix it I will return. But I figure at this price point to get a great phone if the charging case is good not to shabby... If anything changes I will up date review... Phones are a big choice. But so far so good. Everything came with it and it works. No scratches ect
